gaps.sentence: The training course will ___ you to work abroad (QUALIFY).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ify forms the verb: qualify. A base verb follows 'will'.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the best ___ (SCIENCE) in the field.
gaps.hint: plural person needed after 'one of the best'
gaps.explanation: 'One of the best' is followed by a plural noun for people: scientists.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INTERVIEW) asked her some difficult questions.
gaps.hint: the person who asks the questions (-er = doer)
gaps.explanation: The interviewer asks; the interviewee answers. The suffix -er marks the doer.

gaps.sentence: She ___ admitted that she had made a mistake (HONEST).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ly forms adverbs: honestly modifies the verb 'admitted'.

gaps.sentence: The ___ between rich and poor is widening (DIVIDE).
gaps.explanation: The subject must be a noun: division (-sion). 'Divisive' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (PROSPER) of the region depends on tourism.
Her ___ (JUDGE) of character is rarely wrong.
gaps.explanation: 'Her judgement of character' — the noun follows the possessive.
